In Rel-19, further enhancements for TRP TRS requirements and corresponding verification methodologies are introduced: Addressing TRP and TRS requirements for smartphones, conformance test requirements need to be defined for additional NR bands for which core requirements have been defined. This will also include the introduction of conformance test requirements for smartphones supporting UL-MIMO.
